items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I would start as far back as James P. Johnston and Fats Waller, and then I would move up the line into Teddy Wilson, into Art Tatum, into Bud Powell, into Herbie Hancock. I'd say, 'All these guys are my teachers, you know?'

ctx.x: Herbie Jones used to arrange and copy.
Yeah, that's right. Herbie worked close with the old man.
